title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer`
description: packages.lock.json declares a locked package name in packages.lock.json within one edit of `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: NuGet restores exactly these names, so a name that only looks like the intended package brings foreign assemblies into the build. The name this rule expects is `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.lock.json (nuget).
risk: NuGet restores exactly these names, so a name that only looks like the intended package brings foreign assemblies into the build. The name this rule expects is `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer`.
